scope: All 23 Riftlight chapters except the already revised buried bridge
limits: Minutes are uncalibrated predictions excluding dedicated interaction time, not measured sessions.
Shortest paths exclude gated choices per native pacing model; use engine tests for flag-dependent routes.
Matching mechanics ignore prose, cast and art; candidates need human interpretation and are not automatically defects.
Cohesion helper skips interaction edges; its merges, concept and setback walks cannot establish full coverage.
